_comment: myOS machine configuration: the single home for where things live. Paths accept ~, %VAR% and $VAR; relative paths are relative to the myOS folder. Override with MYOS_VAULT / MYOS_PROJECTS_ROOT / MYOS_ORCA_WORKSPACES.
timezone_note: Timestamps are local machine time with UTC offset.

vault_layout._comment: PARA mapped onto the vault's existing numbered folders. Nothing is renamed.

search._comment: Folders agents may search with /context-search. 01-LIFE (personal) is deliberately absent.
search._scope_comment: Agents in a project folder search only their engagement: its projects' vault folders, the engagement's vault_shared (ENGAGEMENT.md) and shared_all_engagements. Notes owned by another engagement's project are never returned. Folders no card owns appear only in the owner view (myOS root or --all-engagements).

graph.provider_description: Anthropic (Claude) via the locally signed-in Claude Code CLI, run through graphify/shim/claude.cmd with no tools, no MCP and no skills

synthetic.description: Synthetic fixture notes. Contains no real data; approval not required.

vault-pilot.description: The myOS pilot area inside the real vault (templates + pilot notes written by myOS).

lumen-ledger.description: EXAMPLE project corpus: Lumen Ledger notes in the vault, minus anything under private/.
lumen-ledger.notes: Add an explicit exclude for any note you know holds secrets, even if the scanner would catch it.

orbit-queue.description: EXAMPLE project corpus for a second, separate engagement.

acme-general.description: EXAMPLE engagement-level corpus: Acme notes not owned by a single project.
